 "rationale": "The budget is 21 uA total at 1.8 V. That splits into IREF of about 5 uA, a 4 uA preamp tail and an 8 uA second stage, giving about 31 uW. The NMOS pair sits at VCM 0.9 V, and the PMOS diode load biases the PMOS CS stage, matched by gm/Id and L, to cancel systematic offset. A minimum-size first inverter keeps the high-impedance node near 6 fF, so it slews in about 0.7 ns. A 6 um inverter drives 50 fF in about 0.2 ns. vinp drives the output-side transistor, so polarity comes out non-inverting."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15, 10, 20),
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "itail":   (4e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),
    "i2":      (8e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),
    "gmid_ld": (10, 7, 14),
    "L_ld":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmid_b":  (12, 8, 15),
    "L_b":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i2 = p["itail"], p["i2"]

    # Bias mirrors: the ibias diode sets the tail and second-stage sink currents.
    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], it, vds=0.3)
    ms = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # Preamp: NMOS input pair with a PMOS mirror load.
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], it / 2, vds=0.4)
    ml = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], it / 2, vds=1.1)

    # Second stage: PMOS CS matched to the load diode (same gm/Id and L) for zero systematic offset.
    mcs = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], i2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MS", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ms)
    # Diode side (M1) gets vinn; output side (M2) gets vinp, so o1 falls when vinp rises.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("ML1", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.dev("ML2", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.dev("MCS", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", mcs)      # o2 rises when vinp rises

    # Inverter 1: minimum size, so it loads o2 lightly (o2 rise -> o3 falls).
    n.M("MI1N", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.0, 0.15)
    # Inverter 2: drives CL (o3 fall -> vout rises), so vout is HIGH when vinp > vinn.
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.5, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 4.5, 0.15)

    # Analytic delay estimate.
    c1 = ml.cdd + m1.cdd + mcs.cgg + 1e-15
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + ml.gds)
    dv1 = min(0.2, a1 * vod)                   # preamp swing needed to switch the CS stage
    t1 = c1 * dv1 / (it / 2)
    inv1_cin = (0.42 + 1.0) * 1.5e-15
    c2 = mcs.cdd + ms.cdd + inv1_cin
    t2 = c2 * (vdd / 2) / i2                   # slew limited by the sink (falling edge)
    inv2_cin = (1.5 + 4.5) * 1.5e-15
    t3 = (inv2_cin + 2e-15) * 0.9 / 60e-6
    t4 = cl * 0.9 / 250e-6                     # PMOS 4.5 um drive
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3 + t4

    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": 0.0, "polarity_ok": 1}
